notes.title: Figurine Shop Simulator is Coming Soon – Add it to Your Wishlist!
notes.content:
🎲 Manage your own figurine shop!

In Figurine Shop Simulator, you're the proud owner of a collectible miniatures store.

🛒 Order stock, 🖌️ paint figurines to increase their value, 📦 build mystery packs, and 💸 handle sales at the register.

👾 Showcase your best pieces on custom display tables and watch clients face off in automated figurine battles!

🎯 More than just a shop sim — it's a tribute to Warhammer fans, TCG collectors, and strategy lovers alike.

🔥 The game is coming soon to Steam — and your support makes all the difference!

👉 Add Figurine Shop Simulator to your Wishlist now to be notified at launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702020/Figurine_Shop_Simulator/
